## Design

### 2026-10-08 – I finished the schematic and wiring of the pcb for day 1 today.

**1.55h**

I finished the schematic and wiring of the pcb for day 1 today.
Today, I set out to work on as much as I can. I began by reading the tutorial for the starbie project, but was confused with the many buttons that I had to press. Luckily, I managed to push through it and was able to move pass the schematic stage.
Before I was about to embark on the wiring stage, I was very much confused on assigning the different footprints to my components. So I asked AI and it guided me through selecting the correct footprints for each layer of my PCB.
Now came the creative part. I had initially decided to stick with the original "star" design but changed it to a rectangle with triangle shape kind of??

![Screenshot 2026-10-08 155348](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/psMpOXqdiJ6q6bdeaJAGnxAnmDRaI95v/1c546f674a08fecf2c2d6ec205a72be6407560d1acaadcaa826ed3817e69a843.png)

However, as I scrolled through different shapes, I was convinced to change my original design into a wing type design.

![Screenshot 2026-10-08 161827](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/psMpOXqdiJ6q6bdeaJAGnxAnmDRaI95v/2d6792cb745e043a527035bd908b262bfdaef8bdd1b479aeb7254d950e5d3239.png)

Then, I had multiple errors such as "Cannot put something on copper track" while trying to wire them together. But I figured out that I had to click on the F.cu in order to get pass this error. Also, I realized that I made a mistake while assigning the footprints because I only had 1 pin instead of 8. So I took quite a while before I came to that realization.

Overall, I was able to wire my Starbie PCB and now could move onto the coding part tomorrow.

### 2026-10-08 – Part 1 of Day 2:

**0.6h**

Part 1 of Day 2:
Today I went ahead and installed all the firmware required for the starbie. Downloading all the required libraries took a while, and it was easy to manuvere because I was already comfortable with Arduino IDE. I went ahead and finished reading the rest of the beginner guide. I also copied and pasted any code needed and went ahead and tried to read the code. However, I kinda do not understand most of it to be honest. Lastly, I ended this session looking for ways to improve my starbie and make it unique. I decided that I will be changing the code to make it do something unique in the next session.

Thats all!
